vb_textbox.text: Start by Clicking the gnome with tall hat, you'll get mushrooms, then when the mushrooms reduce to 1 or 2 then switch to the other smaller hat gnome. Keep doing that one until it goes down to 1 or 2 then switch again. Generally doing this i was getting 6-9 mushrooms each time before it went to 1 and i switched, then would get high ones amounts again from the other gnome. This was the advice given to me by a previous participant and it worked for me too.
